test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 30 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: From an external point P, two tangent segments PA and PB are drawn to a circle with center O and a radius of 5 units. The distance from P to O is 13 units. Calculate the area of quadrilatera PAOB.
solution:
**Given:**

Radius = 5

OP = 13

**Formula Used:**

Tangent length = √(OP² - radius²)

Area = 2 × (1/2 × base × height)

**Calculation:**

⇒ PA = √(13² - 5²)

⇒ PA = √(169 - 25) = √144 = 12

⇒ Area of ΔPAO = 1/2 × 5 × 12 = 30

⇒ Area of ΔPBO = 30

⇒ Area of quadrilateral PAOB = 30 + 30

⇒ Area = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**
